verdict.rationale: mParticle's own docs include a page titled 'Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle', and it documents forwarding rules that filter events before they reach destinations. The evidence is only a page title plus a consent-based forwarding rule. Nothing shows custom code or functions running in the pipeline, or event enrichment. Missing for 10: evidence of custom code/function execution in-pipeline, documented transformation and enrichment mechanics beyond a page title, general-purpose (non-consent) filtering detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can transform, filter, and enrich events in-pipeline with custom code or functions before they reach destinations

citations.quote: Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle
